findings.status: fixed in worktree; no compiled test
findings.title: Imported library NIR had no retained owner
findings.trigger: Compose a child library without recompiling an imported stage; destroy the source library/cache; later use its retained NIR in another link.
findings.fix: Flatten and retain the true NIR owner per imported stage; release each matching reference when destroying the child. No extra NIR clone or codegen/schema change.

findings.status: fixed in worktree; no compiled test
findings.title: NIR deserializer accepted trailing bytes
findings.trigger: A valid serialized NIR record followed by extra bytes reached the common runtime exact-consumption assertion.
findings.fix: Reject trailing bytes alongside overrun and release the partial object before returning a cache miss.

findings.status: fixed in worktree; static model only
findings.title: Repeated traversal in varying-input dependency precheck
findings.trigger: A shared SSA arithmetic DAG was recursively traversed once per path before hoisting FS inputs, allowing exponential compiler work.
findings.fix: Memoize successful dependency checks per implementation, allocate lazily, cancel before mutation on allocation failure. Preserve the existing eligibility and whole-shader rejection rules.

findings.title: Cooperative matrix saturated each term and each K tile
findings.status: fixed in worktree; static arithmetic model only
findings.trigger: With C=INT32_MAX, a positive contribution followed by its negative compensation lost a unit due to intermediate saturation, including across K=8 tile boundaries.
findings.fix: Before dimension splitting, form the complete non-saturating A*B product with a zero accumulator, then perform one saturating elementwise addition with C using RESULT signedness.

findings.title: Flexible cooperative matrix splitter overwrote input C
findings.status: fixed in worktree; static dataflow model only
findings.trigger: For K requiring multiple tiles, the common splitter used the C dereference for intermediate outputs. A later operation reusing that input read a modified matrix.
findings.fix: Copy each C tile into a private accumulator before the multi-K sequence; store only the final tile to the requested destination. This shared Mesa dependency is audited because the transferred TU path calls it.

findings.title: 3D indirect image copy used remaining-layers sentinel as a literal count
findings.status: fixed in source; static slice model only
findings.trigger: A valid3D copy with layerCount=VK_REMAINING_ARRAY_LAYERS recorded up to UINT32_MAX slice draws instead of the remaining mip slices.
findings.fix: Resolve the sentinel against minified3D depth or the array layer count, subtract the base and skip zero remaining slices before view creation. The generic maintenance9 slice helper has different eligibility rules and is not used.

findings.title: Unsynchronized lazy initialization of the E5/UBWC option
findings.status: fixed in source; C++ language initialization rule; no executed concurrency test
findings.trigger: Concurrent image creation read and wrote the same non-atomic static int on first use.
findings.fix: Use a function-local static const bool with C++ guarded initialization. Keep the opt-in value and default unchanged.

not_findings.title: cmd token in perf_debug argument
not_findings.reason: perf_debug does not expand its device argument; no undeclared identifier reaches C++ compilation. No patch.

not_findings.title: Mesh VPC merged-mask table
not_findings.reason: regid is uint8_t, so regid>>2 remains inside the64-entry table. No out-of-bounds patch inferred.

not_findings.title: TU command-stream allocation count/size
not_findings.reason: tu_cs_alloc takes count,size in dwords. The mesh passthrough allocation (1,32) provides the128 bytes copied; no argument-order error.

not_findings.title: Dynamic FRAG_RESULT remap option
not_findings.reason: The new fragdata_dynamic_remap option is wired for meta clear shaders in tu_clear_blit.cc, which change output slots at execution. Ordinary FDM is not itself a render-target slot remap. No extra tu_shader.cc flag inferred.

not_findings.title: Dedicated shared atomic increment source
not_findings.reason: The local ISA describes atomic.inc as a one-source operation; the parser retains an extra dummy source. No wrap-at-source-limit semantics inferred from unrelated GPUs.

not_findings.title: Apparent duplicate task lowering
not_findings.reason: The duplicate came from overlapping display ranges; only one source call exists.

not_findings.title: Indirect copy four-byte tail
not_findings.reason: VkCopyMemoryIndirectCommandKHR requires source, destination and size to be four-byte aligned (10958..10960). The word-copy loop has no valid sub-word tail to implement.

not_findings.title: RGB9E5 indirect format decoding
not_findings.reason: copy_format already reinterprets E5B9G9R9 as R32_UINT before tu_get_indirect_copy_format; no new shared-exponent unpacker needed for this copy path.
